Responder pelo controle de fichas e formulários de Saúde, Segurança e Meio Ambiente - SSMA, visando o atendimento a requisitos legais e procedimentos internos da empresa.

Realizar estudos e análises dos riscos físicos, químicos, biológicos, mecânicos, ergonômicos e de acidentes, existentes nos locais de trabalho, indicando medidas de controle de acordo com o cargo e função exercida e propondo medidas de proteção e prevenção. Controlar e atualizar os indicadores de SSMA, estruturando ações a partir de estatísticas para tomada de decisões operacionais e gerenciais.

Realizar a gestão dos custos de SSMA, através planilhas eletrônicas e análise para apresentação aos gestores para conhecimento e tomada de decisão. Dar suporte técnico ao gestor, na elaboração e atualização dos procedimentos operacionais, visando identificar e detalhar as atividades, mapeando riscos e medidas de controle existentes a fim de garantir a execução da tarefa com segurança.

Ministrar treinamentos de segurança do trabalho, demonstrando e conscientizando os colaboradores sobre condições de trabalho perigosas, medidas preventivas de segurança e de atuação adequada ao tipo de operação executada. Identificar, através de visitas a campo, condições de trabalho e comportamentos inseguros, agindo preventivamente para evitar qualquer tipo de dano pessoal, material e/ou ambiental.

Notificar os colaboradores e liderança sobre atos ou condições inseguras, indicando as ações necessárias para corrigi-las, inclusive orientando sobre a política de consequências da empresa e as medidas disciplinares cabíveis. Registrar as ocorrências de acidentes/incidentes envolvendo pessoas, máquinas e/ou equipamentos.

Prestar suporte técnico na investigação de ocorrências de acidentes/incidentes envolvendo pessoas, máquinas e/ou equipamentos, apoiando na estruturação das ações para evitar as reincidências destas ocorrências. Providenciar atendimento ambulatorial ao acidentado, encaminhando para atendimento hospitalar, após avaliação do profissional de saúde.

Participar nos programas e campanhas de educação sanitária, preparando e distribuindo material de divulgação, e auxiliando na orientação dos colaboradores quanto à aquisição de hábitos de saúde e prevenção de doenças. Controlar os atestados de saúde ocupacional da unidade, identificando vencimentos, encaminhando colaboradores para exames de regularização, em atendimento a legislação vigente.

Participar de reuniões com o cliente com objetivo de repassar informações pertinentes de SSMA, obtendo apoio para a execução de ações. Participar de auditorias do cliente e do corporativo com objetivo de identificar a conformidade do processo SSMA.

Efetuar a gestão de compra, armazenamento e distribuição de materiais de segurança para toda a unidade. Efetuar a gestão de contratos de prestação de serviços da unidade relacionados à segurança, desde a contratação, fiscalização e medição no sistema.

Responder pela qualidade, confiabilidade e desempenho dos recursos, serviços e informações geradas pelas tarefas sob sua responsabilidade, mantendo o sigilo sobre assuntos relacionados às atividades da empresa. Conhecer, aplicar, promover, cumprir, fazer cumprir e sugerir normas e condutas voltadas para a segurança no trabalho e preservação ambiental, contribuindo para a eliminação de situações que possam representar riscos de acidentes no trabalho e degradação do meio ambiente.

Apoiar o gestor em assuntos inerentes à sua área de atuação, apresentando e discutindo problemas e irregularidades, a fim de subsidiar a definição de procedimentos e ações a serem adotadas. Elaborar e acompanhar o DDS (Diálogo Diário de Segurança), participando da escolha dos temas e auxiliando na preparação de material.

  • Inglês básico/intermediário.

  • High level of proficiency in written and spoken English. (To be considered for this position, you must submit your resume in English)

Nice to haves:

Company Description

Louis Dreyfus Company es una empresa líder en la comercialización y transformación de productos agrícolas. Nuestras actividades abarcan toda la cadena de valor, desde el campo hasta la mesa, a través de una amplia gama de líneas de negocio, aprovechamos nuestro alcance global y nuestra extensa red de activos para servir a nuestros clientes y consumidores en todo el mundo. Estructurada como una organización matricial de seis regiones geográficas y diez plataformas, Louis Dreyfus Company opera en más de 100 países y emplea aproximadamente a 18.000 personas en todo el mundo.

Job Description

Como Solution Specialist, serás el referente para la solución SAP Plant Maintenance y Non-Commodities Inventory.

Serás responsable de definir y establecer la solución objetivo, comenzando desde una visión conceptual inicial y evolucionando hacia una especificación más concreta. Tomarás decisiones de alto nivel de diseño, siguiendo la estrategia del negocio, y definirás estándares, directrices y mejores prácticas, identificando impactos en el sistema de información. Deberás entender los requisitos del negocio, preparar o revisar especificaciones, colaborar eficazmente con otros miembros del equipo funcional y técnico, hacer recomendaciones y consolidar todos los requisitos en una o varias soluciones.

Una vez que las especificaciones estén establecidas y las soluciones definidas, asegurarás la entrega de la solución en conjunto con el resto del equipo.

En esta posición, tendrás tres roles principales que cubren un amplio alcance de responsabilidades:

Eres el guardián de la integración de Plant Maintenance y Non-Commodities Inventory con el resto del ecosistema:

  • Comprender las necesidades del negocio y traducirlas en una solución.
  • Diseñar flujos de procesos cruzados junto con otros miembros del equipo.
  • Trabajar de cerca y con confianza con varios departamentos.
  • Garantizar el mantenimiento y la mejora de tu proceso.

Actúas como socio de confianza para la mejora continua y a largo plazo:

  • Gestionar la relación con el negocio para definir prioridades y valor.
  • Asegurar la comunicación y ser responsable de tus indicadores (KPIs medibles).
  • Animar, informar, comunicar, mejorar, anticipar y colaborar con otros dominios para garantizar un diseño de extremo a extremo.
  • Elaborar planes de acción para mejoras continuas y resolución de incidentes recurrentes.

Formas parte de la implementación de iniciativas mundiales:

Participarás como miembro del equipo en la hoja de ruta mundial de S/4.

Resumen de responsabilidades:

  • Responsable de SAP Plant Maintenance y Non-Commodities Inventory, incluyendo integración con otros flujos.
  • Tomar decisiones de diseño de soluciones como propietario de las soluciones y procesos SAP Plant Maintenance y Non-Commodities Inventory.
  • Gestionar la relación con el negocio para asegurar prioridades y valor.
  • Proponer mejoras para generar valor a largo plazo.

Habilidades IT

  • (Debe) Experiencia en mejores prácticas de TI.

Engineers who thrive at Canonical are mindful of the dynamics of the open source ecosystem, and equally aware of the needs of large, innovative organizations.
This job involves international travel several times a year, usually for one week at a time.

Em 2007 nasceu a GolSat, especialista em tecnologia para gestão de frotas leves. Our global teams deliver transformative digital solutions and customer experiences for industry leaders in consumer electronics, finance, telecommunications, and utilities. With robust multi-shore delivery capabilities, multi-language programs, and secure infrastructure, we ensure exceptional service backed by our multi-billion-dollar parent company.

Location and Flexibility

This is a hybrid role. This model requires the ability to work in a hybrid mode from one of our offices in São Paulo (2 times/ week or 8 days/ month) or Porto Alegre (3 times/ week or 12 days/ month). Our WFN culture is designed to foster in-person innovation, collaboration, and connection with team members local and visiting from other global offices.

The Opportunity

As a Tech Lead (Android), you will be at the forefront of our dynamic team, leading the design of applications, tools, and processes while ensuring value, clarity, and maintainability. Your role will involve expertly navigating and enhancing client tech stacks, executing large-scale refactors, and advocating for world-class engineering practices. You will be instrumental in driving teams to reduce change fail percentages, resolving conflicts, advocating for new practices, and tailoring your communication to diverse scenarios. Furthermore, you are expected to tackle psychological safety impediments and mentor team members, fostering a conducive work environment across the entire build cycle.

Responsibilities

  • Lead the team and client in designing applications, tools, and processes, optimizing for value, clarity, and maintainability.
  • Plan and drive execution of large-scale refactors across the software ecosystem, managing dependencies and minimizing risk.
  • Use your strong understanding of the Android development lifecycle and ecosystem to help the team navigate non-trivial testing scenarios, such as video streaming, Bluetooth, and other peripherals, poor network conditions, etc.
  • Champion the adoption and implementation of new practices for project teams and clients, while using IDE’s, version control like Git, and command line tools effectively.
  • On-Call Support: This role includes periodic on-call duties to support our critical systems. Aligned with our commitment to work-life balance, we maintain a strict 10-hour daily work limit, even during on-call periods. Team members may be required to respond to issues outside of regular business hours on a rotational basis. Compensation for on-call duty is provided in accordance with Brazilian labor laws.

Qualifications

  • Proven experience (10+ years) as an Android Engineer, with a track record of leading complex projects.
  • Deep understanding of client tech stacks and the ability to integrate and improve them over a series of projects.
  • Demonstrated ability to plan and execute large-scale refactors across the software ecosystem.
  • Strong understanding of the Android development Lifecycle and ecosystem including languages, frameworks, and libraries (Java, Kotlin, Room, Coroutines/Flow, RxJava, Dagger 2, Gradle, Fragments, OkHttp3, Retrofit or Volley).
  • Comfort with IDE’s, version control systems such as Git, and command-line tools.
  • Familiarity with CI/CD (e.g., Jenkins, CircleCI, Azure, GitHub Actions) and experience setting up deployment pipelines.
  • Experience in frequently using frameworks such as Espresso, JUnit, Mockito/Mockk to write automated tests for your code.
  • Proven ability to recognize symptoms of various impediments to psychological safety and provide effective support.

Bonus Points

  • Expertise in choosing and executing deployment strategies that minimize risk and maximize client ROI.
  • Deep understanding and empathy for client hesitations around frequent releases, with proven strategies on how to overcome those hurdles.
  • Proven ability to balance helping and teaching with the need to finish things.
  • Demonstrated ability to work across a team to identify the level of support each team member needs in implementing different features.

Why TELUS Digital?

At TELUS Digital, you’ll work with world-class brands like FOX, HBO, PepsiCo, and Domino's, building transformative digital products that impact millions. Our global reach allows you to collaborate with diverse, international teams, solving complex problems and delivering tech-driven solutions that matter.

We thrive on engineering excellence, using the latest technologies in cloud computing, AI, machine learning, DevOps, microservices architecture, and data engineering. Sobre a Oportunidade e Desafios:

  • Ser referência no relacionamento com os escritórios B2B, direcionando e garantindo eficiência e qualidade na receita da operação.
  • Realizar o planejamento comercial mensal e definir os focos de distribuição para cada mês.
  • Ser referência de Produtos Financeiros e Cross-sell.
  • Conduzir comitês de resultados e monitorar as vendas para garantir que os escritórios estejam alinhados com as metas e o budget estabelecido.
  • Coordenar campanhas e esforços dos times internos da XP, promovendo sinergia e colaboração.
  • Conhecimento de mercado, alocação e produtos.
  • Capacidade analítica.
  • Capacidade crítica.
  • Visão estratégica.
  • Organização processual.

Diferenciais:

  • Ter profundidade técnica em produtos/mercado.

Localidade: São Paulo

Processo Seletivo

Triagem inicial: Análise do currículo para verificar a adequação às qualificações e requisitos da vaga.

Testes gerais: Avaliação do alinhamento cultural com o teste da Mindsight e teste de raciocínio lógico da Predictive Index.

Vídeo entrevista: Uma oportunidade para nos conhecermos melhor e entender suas motivações e experiências.

Entrevista com a equipe de Recrutamento: Discussão sobre as expectativas em relação à vaga e aos objetivos profissionais.

Avaliação técnica: (Entrevista/dinâmica/teste ) focado nas habilidades específicas necessárias para a função.

Entrevista com a liderança: Uma conversa para discutir sua visão e como você pode contribuir para a equipe e a empresa.

Entrevista com colegas de trabalho: Interação com futuros pares para avaliar a sinergia e o trabalho em equipe.

Entrevista focada em cultura: Exploração dos valores e princípios da empresa para garantir um bom encaixe cultural.

Oferta: Apresentação da proposta de trabalho, incluindo detalhes sobre remuneração e benefícios.

  • Saúde e bem-estar: plano de saúde, plano odontológico, Gympass, Zenklub, VA, VR, New Value, seguro de vida.
  • Maternidade e Paternidade: auxílio creche para pais e mães, licença maternidade de 6 meses, licença paternidade de 20 dias.
  • Só na XP Inc.: assessoria de investimento e acesso a fundos de investimentos exclusivos.

Jornada de trabalho com flexibilidade: O nosso modelo de trabalho varia de acordo com a função: presencial para frentes de negócio e híbrido para as demais equipes. É importante ressaltar que todos os colaboradores precisam morar na localidade da vaga (nossa sede está localizada na cidade de São Paulo e é onde temos o maior número de posições), já que temos atividades que exigem a presença física para promover a colaboração e os rituais da nossa cultura. Esses encontros são organizados de acordo com as orientações dos líderes e as particularidades de cada rotina, para que nossos colaboradores possam exercer suas jornadas de trabalho com liberdade e autonomia.

description:
Come work at the forefront of science - and help the brands you grew up with grow and evolve into the next generation.

Job Description - Accountant Analyst (2407026616W)

Legal Entity Accountant

Who we are

At Kenvue, we realize the extraordinary power of everyday care. Built on over a century of heritage and rooted in science, we’re the house of iconic brands - including Neutrogena, Aveeno, Tylenol, Listerine, Johnson’s and BAND-AID Brand Adhesive Bandages that you already know and love. Science is our passion; care is our talent. Our global team is made up of ~22,000 diverse and brilliant people, passionate about insights, innovation and committed to delivering the best products to our customers. With expertise and empathy, being a Kenvuer means having the power to impact the life of millions of people every day. We put people first, care fiercely, earn trust with science and solve with courage – and have brilliant opportunities waiting for you! Join us in shaping our future – and yours.

What you will do

The Legal Entity Accountant is responsible for:

Key Responsibilities

  1. Responsible for the completeness and accuracy of both the US and Local GAAP & Tax reporting. This includes but is not limited to recording the statutory ledgers and maintaining accuracy of parallel ledgers (if applicable), focusing on ensuring the correct tax accounting and coordination with internal and external audit teams.
  2. Responsible for the complete and accurate accounting for all the General process flows for the Balance Sheet and Income Statement.
  3. Timely closing & execution of financial periods as per closing calendar and in accordance with Compliance, Internal Audit & SOX requirements.
  4. Accountable for completeness, accuracy and validity of the actuals reported within process/entity scope.
  5. Regular focus on Balance Sheet reconciliations to minimize open items.
  6. Influence and execute process improvements, generating ideas and implementing them in line with global standards.
  7. Take the statement of cash flows under IFRS for the legal entities under its responsibility.
  8. Make the reconciliation between local and corporate figures.
  9. Perform supervision tasks to analysts that include performance evaluation, disciplinary actions, etc.
  10. Ensure accuracy and adherence to Corporate policies and IFRS.

Compliance

  1. Support auditors and legal authorities with the execution of required activities.

title: Engenheiro de Produção -  Manaus/AM
description:
A Mirandex começou sua história em meados de 1994, ainda como distribuidora de Vidros Brasil de Rondônia, atuando no ramo de distribuição de chapas e vidros em comum. Em 1998, começou a procura pelo vidro temperado no Estado, o que ainda era uma novidade. Desde então, começamos a revender o vidro temperado que era produzido nos grandes centros do país. O aumento da demanda, a dificuldade de compra e transporte, além do prazo de entrega, fizeram com que nos inspirássemos a montar uma indústria própria. Então em 2000, inauguramos nossa indústria de vidro temperado, a primeira do estado de Rondônia, com forno de têmpera vertical. Cada vez mais aquecido, o mercado exigia novos produtos e mais rapidez de entrega. Visando isso, em 2002, demos um grande passo ao adquirir um forno horizontal de tecnologia americana, que produzia vidros com mais rapidez e qualidade. Dessa forma, a Mirandex se torna a maior empresa do ramo vidraceiro da região Norte do Brasil.

Suas principais atividades serão:

  1. Planejar, organizar e supervisionar as atividades de produção, dentro das especificações e padrões de qualidade estabelecidos, visando a assegurar o cumprimento dos objetivos da empresa na área comercial.
  2. Supervisionar a elaboração do plano anual de metas de produção, visando à otimização dos recursos produtivos disponíveis.
  3. Supervisionar a elaboração dos cronogramas de fabricação, visando a garantir a melhor alocação da mão-de-obra, equipamentos e materiais.
  4. Controlar as despesas gerais do departamento de produção (energia elétrica, custos de manutenção, insumos etc.), visando a contribuir para a redução de custos nesses itens.
  5. Analisar e avaliar os aspectos econômicos do processo produtivo, no tocante a mão-de-obra e quantidade de materiais consumidos, visando a identificar oportunidades ou alternativas que permitam a redução de custos.
  6. Elaborar procedimentos e determinar diretrizes para manutenção do visual da fábrica, no que se refere a limpeza, pintura, conservação etc., visando a manter o local em condições que propiciem o melhor desempenho dos funcionários e dos equipamentos.
  7. Estudar, desenvolver e/ou aperfeiçoar processos, equipamentos, ferramental etc., bem como estabelecer controles de processos, visando garantir melhor qualidade e maior produtividade. Acompanhar e controlar sistematicamente o desempenho da produção, por meio da análise de indicadores gerenciais apropriados, propondo os planos e ações necessários, visando assegurar o cumprimento das metas e objetivos estabelecidos.
  8. Supervisionar as atividades de inspeção de materiais e de controle de qualidade da matéria-prima, visando assegurar conformidade com as especificações e padrões de qualidade estabelecidos.
  9. Supervisionar as atividades de estocagem de produtos acabados, visando assegurar conformidade com as especificações estabelecidas.
  10. Acompanhar a execução de auditorias, visando a identificar necessidades de alterações/modificações que permitam a obtenção das certificações.

About Eightx

We provide Fractional CFO services for fast-growing eCommerce Brands and Agencies from Canada, the United States, and the United Kingdom with one goal in mind:

To help eCommerce business owners scale their businesses with more cash and less stress.

 This requires a broad range of skills including financial modelling, risk management, understanding of US/Canadian GAAP, financing, audit, investor relations and more.

We are small but growing fast which means you will get the chance to specialize and grow into future roles such as Finance Manager or VP Finance.

Lastly, as you might expect of a finance company, we work really hard when we need to, but we don't work hard just for the sake of it. We don't miss our kids' concerts, we work out during the day and we usually sign off early on Fridays.

About The Position

You are the best financial analyst you know. You never get stuck on problems. You create new ideas and workflows without being asked.

You will be assisting a portfolio of clients around the world with financial modeling, budgeting, cash flow forecasting, scenario planning, variance analysis, and more.

You will build 3-statement financial models from the ground up, then run and adjust them every month according to client's actual results.

You will be working in a wide range of tech/software platforms including Shopify, Quickbooks Online, Xero, Google Sheets, Google Docs, Glew.io, Amazon Seller/Vendor, Rippling, Gusto, and more.

Salary

You will be paid near the top of your field for your experience and education.

Time Zone

Financial Modelling

We build forecasts that are realistic, robust, and useful for decision-making.

  • Build 3-statement, dynamic financial models
  • Every month (minimum) adjust the models and communicate potential issues to clients, CFOs, etc
  • Collect data on scenarios to analyze in the model
  • Perform market research to make the models even more realistic

Financial Reporting

We look backward so we can look forward to manage cashflow and mitigate risk.

  • Monthly financial reporting package with analysis and commentary
  • Creating and updating KPI dashboards
  • Creating and updating 3-statement financial forecasts
  • Cash flow monitoring and forecasting
  • Updating Board and Investor reporting decks

What You Must Have

  • You are a Microsoft Excel expert
  • You are incredibly fast at building, updating and troubleshooting financial models
  • You understand North American accounting principles
  • You are self-motivated
  • You can use judgement and creativity to solve problems
  • You are happy to work in a fast-paced environment
  • You take ownership of your work and mistakes
  • You are comfortable not knowing everything. You can use your professional skills to make inferences to move projects along

Your Experience And Education

  • You have a Bachelors Degree
  • You have a professional designation or Masters Degree (CPA, CA, MFin, MSc)
  • You have 5+ years experience as a financial analyst

Submit your resume and a short video in your application. Answer these questions:

  • Why are you interested in this position?
  • What do you know about our company?
  • What is your ideal work environment?
  • What are your strengths?
  • Where do you see yourself in five years?

For your video:

Applications without a video will be ignored.

title: Analista de Compliance Pleno
description:
Job description

Somos uma equipe de mais de 4 mil pessoas construindo soluções inovadoras e tecnológicas para meios de pagamento, customer experience e fidelização e incentivo de clientes. Desde 1992, integramos e conectamos empresas do setor financeiro, varejistas, empresas de serviços e consumidores em todo o Brasil. Assim, nos mantemos pioneiros no lançamento de produtos e soluções que transformam e facilitam o dia a dia de milhares de pessoas.

Se você possui experiência com Compliance, PLD/AML, investigações internas e análise de riscos, essa área é pra você!

Aqui o foco é garantir conformidade, prevenir fraudes, monitorar transações suspeitas e investigar possíveis irregularidades. Tudo isso com alto impacto e responsabilidade!



Main responsibilities

1. PLD/AML (Prevenção à Lavagem de Dinheiro e Financiamento do Terrorismo)

  • Monitoramento e análise de transações financeiras suspeitas .
  • Implementação, revisão e manutenção de políticas e procedimentos de PLD/AML .
  • Análise de perfis e comportamentos financeiros para identificar padrões de lavagem de dinheiro .
  • Envio de comunicações obrigatórias para órgãos reguladores (ex: COAF no Brasil).
  • Uso de ferramentas de busca de informações e procedimentos de due diligence para verificação de clientes e parceiros de negócios.
  • Realização de treinamentos internos para conscientização sobre lavagem de dinheiro.

2. Background Check de Clientes e Fornecedores

  • KYC (Know Your Customer) : Avaliação de informações e histórico para verificação de identidade, entre outras informações, origem de recursos e reputação do cliente.
  • KYS (Know Your Supplier) : Análise de dados, impedimentos, avaliação da idoneidade e conformidade de fornecedores e terceiros.
  • Consulta a listas restritivas e de sanções (OFAC, ONU, BACEN, entre outras).
  • Investigação de conflitos de interesse e riscos de fraude.
  • Avaliação de propriedade real (Beneficial Ownership) para identificar beneficiários finais de empresas.

3. Monitoramento e Investigações Internas

  • Acompanhamento de indicadores de compliance e identificação de desvios de conduta, financeira entre outras não conformidades.
  • Investigação de denúncias internas e análise de comportamentos suspeitos, identificando prováveis descumprimento de políticas internas.
  • Atuar nas reclamações recebidas através do canal denúncias , averiguando a veracidade e as informações recebidas, sugerindo uma ação para adequação das regras éticas, convívio e de bom comportamento na empresa.
  • Aplicação de auditorias e revisões periódicas nos processos internos.

4. Relatórios e Comunicação com Órgãos Reguladores

  • Elaboração de relatórios ou apresentações periódicas para utilização interna ou externa da empresa, apresentando os apontamentos recebidos, bem como o plano de ação adotado.
  • Comunicação de operações suspeitas para entidades reguladoras.
  • Manutenção de registros e documentação de compliance.

5. Atualização Regulatória e Treinamentos

  • Acompanhamento das emissões e/ou mudanças nas novas regulamentações na legislação, avaliando e definindo junto as áreas envolvidas o cumprimento e as ações necessárias para manter a empresa compliance com as regulamentações.
  • Treinamento contínuo de funcionários para garantir a conformidade.
  • Desenvolvimento e atualização dos manuais de compliance , acompanhamento dos vencimentos das políticas, atuando junto as áreas para garantir a conformidade e adequação as regras definidas.
  • Apoiar na execução dos trabalhos planejados, emitindo diagnósticos, avaliando a eficiência e eficácia do ambiente de controles dos processos auditados.


Requirements and skills

• Formação superior completa ou cursando Administração de Empresas, Economia, ou cursos correlatos.

• Pacote office

• Conhecimento de regulamentações, políticas, normas e práticas de Compliance.

• Conhecimento dos sistemas/plataformas E-guardian, KN-1, MK consultoria, RISK, G-Certifica.

description:
Conheça a nossa história!

Na Imex acreditamos que a inovação é a chave para um futuro mais saudável. Somos uma empresa inovadora, com uma forte presença no mercado de saúde e tecnologia. Com mais de 20 anos de história, somos especialistas nesse segmento e a nossa missão é transformar o setor de saúde por meio de equipamentos médicos de alta qualidade, tanto para uso humano quanto veterinário, atuando em todo o Brasil.

Aqui valorizamos o compromisso com resultados e a colaboração entre as pessoas. Valorizamos o comprometimento, a diversidade e a autenticidade de cada um, e acreditamos que quando todos crescem juntos, o impacto é ainda maior.

Qual será o seu papel?

Como Especialista Técnico em Equipamentos de Diagnóstico por Imagem , você será responsável por garantir a instalação, manutenção e suporte técnico dos nossos equipamentos de diagnóstico por imagem, garantindo a qualidade e a confiabilidade de nossos produtos no campo. Seu trabalho será essencial para o bom funcionamento dos equipamentos nos hospitais e clínicas, sempre buscando a excelência no atendimento aos nossos clientes.

Responsabilidades e atribuições

Como será o seu dia a dia?

  • Realizar instalação, calibração e manutenção preventiva e corretiva dos equipamentos de diagnóstico por imagem (radiologia, ultrassonografia, tomografia, entre outros);
  • Oferecer suporte técnico remoto e presencial aos clientes, solucionando dúvidas e problemas técnicos;
  • Treinar usuários sobre a operação e manutenção dos equipamentos;
  • Diagnosticar falhas e realizar reparos de acordo com os procedimentos da empresa;
  • Acompanhar e controlar os indicadores de performance dos equipamentos, gerando relatórios técnicos para os gestores;
  • Trabalhar em estreita colaboração com as equipes de vendas, engenharia e atendimento ao cliente para garantir a satisfação dos clientes;
  • Assegurar que todos os procedimentos de segurança e regulamentações técnicas sejam seguidos rigorosamente.

Requisitos e qualificações

Para fazer a sua história acontecer aqui, precisamos que você domine esses assuntos:

  • Formação técnica ou superior em áreas como Engenharia Biomédica, Engenharia Eletrônica, Física Médica ou áreas correlatas;
  • Experiência prévia com equipamentos de diagnóstico por imagem (radiologia, ultrassonografia, tomografia, etc.);
  • Conhecimento em processos de manutenção e calibração de equipamentos médicos;
  • Capacidade de diagnosticar e resolver problemas técnicos com agilidade e precisão;

Agora, se você quiser se diferenciar, é bom você ter…

  • Inglês técnico para leitura de manuais e normas internacionais;

title: Programa ELEVA 2025
description:
A Gentil Negócios, o maior franqueado do Grupo Boticário no Brasil, acredita que o varejo é feito por pessoas e impulsionado por líderes que transformam desafios em oportunidades. O ELEVA 2025 é mais do que um programa de trainee interno – é um caminho para quem deseja liderar, inovar e crescer dentro da GN.

Se você tem ambição de construir uma trajetória de liderança, gosta de desafios e quer desenvolver habilidades essenciais para gerir pessoas e negócios no varejo, essa é a sua chance!

O ELEVA 2025 é um programa intensivo e exclusivo para colaboradores da GN que buscam desenvolvimento acelerado. Durante a jornada, você terá acesso a:

- Formação estratégica : mais de 200 horas de aprendizado teórico e prático, ministrado por especialistas da GN;
- Desenvolvimento hands-on : desafios reais e imersão no dia a dia do varejo;
- Mentoria e acompanhamento personalizado : aprendizado guiado por líderes experientes;
- Projetos estratégicos: atuação em iniciativas que impactam diretamente os resultados da empresa;
- Networking e protagonismo : troca de experiências com diferentes áreas e exposição a desafios de alto impacto.

O ELEVA é destinado a colaboradores internos da GN que:

Possuem mais de 90 dias na empresa;
Demonstram potencial de liderança e desejo de crescimento;
São realizadores, orientados para resultados e aprendizado contínuo;
Têm habilidades de gestão ágil, comunicação eficaz e visão estratégica;
Querem fazer parte do grupo que vai liderar o futuro da GN.
Curso superior (concluído ou em andamento), preferencialmente em áreas relacionadas ao negócio.

O que esperamos de você?

- EXECUÇÃO: Agilidade, foco em resultados e capacidade de resolver desafios com rapidez.
- COMUNICAÇÃO: Clareza, influência e habilidade para engajar equipes e criar conexões.
- PLANEJAMENTO: Visão estratégica para antecipar tendências e otimizar processos.

O varejo exige líderes que saibam agir, inspirar e inovar. No ELEVA, você vai desenvolver exatamente isso.

Pronto para elevar sua carreira?

Se você se enxerga como parte desse movimento de crescimento e transformação, sua jornada começa aqui.

Atividades:

AULAS & FORMAÇÃO TEÓRICA

Os participantes terão acesso a um conteúdo exclusivo, com mais de 200 horas de capacitação , ministrado por especialistas da GN. Os temas abordam desde gestão operacional e liderança de equipes até estratégia comercial e inovação no varejo . A participação assídua nas aulas é um compromisso fundamental do trainee , pois cada módulo é essencial para sua evolução no programa.

Durante toda a jornada, os trainees contarão com o apoio de mentores , que irão acompanhar seu desenvolvimento, oferecer feedbacks estratégicos e auxiliá-los na aplicação prática do conhecimento adquirido.

ESTÁGIO PRÁTICO & IMERSÃO NA OPERAÇÃO

Para garantir um aprendizado realista e aplicado, os participantes passarão por um período de imersão nas operações da Gentil , assumindo desafios reais e exercitando sua capacidade de gestão, liderança e resolução de problemas no dia a dia do varejo.

TRABALHO DE CONCLUSÃO & PROJETO FINAL

Ao final do programa, os trainees desenvolverão um projeto estratégico , aplicando as competências adquiridas ao longo da formação. Esse trabalho será apresentado para a diretoria da GN, consolidando a trajetória de aprendizado e demonstrando o impacto gerado pelo trainee.

O ELEVA exige comprometimento, disciplina e dedicação . A frequência nas aulas, participação ativa nas mentorias e engajamento nas atividades práticas são critérios essenciais para o desenvolvimento e progressão no programa.

Python and Kubernetes Software Engineer - Data, Workflows, AI/ML & Analytics

Join to apply for the Python and Kubernetes Software Engineer - Data, Workflows, AI/ML & Analytics role at Canonical .

Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is widely used in enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering, and IoT. Our customers include top public cloud and silicon providers, along with industry leaders. We are a pioneer in global distributed collaboration, with 1000+ colleagues in 70+ countries, mostly working remotely, with occasional in-person meetings.

We are hiring Python and Kubernetes Specialist Engineers to develop open source solutions for public cloud and private infrastructure, focusing on Data, Workflows, AI/ML, and Analytics.

As a software engineer, you will work on end-to-end data analytics and MLOps solutions using tools like Kubeflow, MLFlow, DVC, Feast, Apache Superset, dbt, Airflow, Temporal, Apache Trino, and ClickHouse, deploying on servers or cloud, on Kubernetes, desktops, or as web services.

Our mission is to enable broader access to open source technology, serving individual users and large enterprises alike. Many team members are remote, with most in similar time zones for effective collaboration.

What your day will look like

  • Develop understanding of Linux stack components
  • Design, build, and maintain solutions on cloud and local environments
  • Master distributed systems concepts like observability and tracing
  • Work with Kubernetes and open-source applications
  • Collaborate with a distributed team of engineers, designers, and product managers
  • Debug issues and engage with upstream communities
  • Share ideas and collaborate on solutions

What we are looking for in you

  • Experience in software delivery using Python
  • Strong academic background
  • Degree in a technical field or relevant experience
  • Confidence in communication and feedback exchange
  • Proven track record of exceeding expectations
  • Passion for technology demonstrated through personal projects

  • Excellent English communication skills
  • Experience with Linux (Debian/Ubuntu preferred)
  • Interpersonal skills, curiosity, flexibility, accountability
  • Appreciation for diversity and multicultural environments
  • Self-motivation and thoughtfulness
  • Result-oriented with a commitment to meet deadlines
  • Ability to travel twice a year for company events

Additional skills that would be nice to have

  • Experience building automated ML solutions and data pipelines

  • Experience with container tech (Docker, LXD, Kubernetes)
  • Experience with public clouds (AWS, Azure, GCP)
  • Knowledge of cloud computing
  • Passion for software quality and testing
  • Open source project experience

What we offer colleagues

  • Distributed work environment with biannual in-person sprints
  • Learning and development budget of USD 2,000/year
  • Annual compensation review and recognition rewards
  • Holiday, maternity, and paternity leave
  • Employee Assistance Programme
  • Travel opportunities to meet colleagues
  • Travel upgrades for company events

About Canonical

Canonical is a pioneer in open source, publisher of Ubuntu, and at the forefront of AI, IoT, and cloud technology. We hire globally, set high standards, and promote excellence. Most employees work remotely, embracing a flexible, innovative environment.

Canonical is an equal opportunity employer, committed to diversity and inclusion. We consider all applications fairly, regardless of background or identity.

Aqui, valorizamos a inovação, colaboração, sentimento de dono, foco no cliente, atitude descomplicada e ágil, e a mão-na-massa. Your Journey at Concentrix + Webhelp Starts Here:

At Concentrix + Webhelp, our mission is to be the greatest customer engagement services company in the world, rich in diversity and talent. We believe in doing right by and for people, our clients, their customers, our staff, our communities, and our planet.

In our Information Technology and Global Security team, you will deliver cutting-edge technology infrastructure, transformative software solutions and industry-leading global security for our staff and clients. You will work with the best in the world to design, implement and strategize IT, security, application development, innovation, and solutions in today’s hyperconnected world. You will be part of the technology team that is core to our vision of design, build and run the future of CX.

We’re a remote-first company looking to hire the absolute best talent in the world.

#LI-Hybrid

Role Overview

The Network Engineer is part of our 24x7 first level support network team focused on both network outages as well as network-related projects. Will be accountable for day-to-day network activities, such as those related to incident and change management, to ensure end user requests are handled and addressed within defined SLAs. You will report to the Director, Global Networking. You will work onsite along with an excellent team of engineers.

Requirements

  • Advanced English Speaker. Fluent in verbal and written English. High Proficiency level (85% >)
  • 4+ years of experience in Networking (LAN/ WAN & Security)
  • Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science or Engineering (desired); Cisco Certifications such as CCNA, CCNP, Fortinet Certifications FCNSA, FCNSP and ITIL (desired).
  • Experience with Cisco Firewalls, Routers, Switches, FortiGate UTM
  • Deep knowledge with proven expertise of Cisco, FortiGate, Brocade networking products, Load balancers, Firewalls, Routers, Switches, UTMs, Wi-Fi (Cisco/Fortinet/Aruba), maintaining and troubleshooting
  • Expertise in networking concepts such as IPLCs, Leased Lines, MPLS, TI/T3/ E1, VoIP, VPN tunnels etc.
  • Proficient configuring WAN links, VLANs and protocols such as TCP/IP, SNMP, OSPF, BGP, RIP etc.
  • Solid background in network security from the desktop level to the network gateway and perimeter level
  • Proven experience implementing and troubleshooting WAN protocols such as BGP, OSPF, RIP etc. and security mechanisms such as IPSec/AES/3DES/SSL.

Responsibilities

  • Provide 24x7 L1 network operational support of existing network, capacity planning, conduct infrastructure audits, configure security policies/VPNs
  • Provide troubleshooting support to maintain all network systems and monitor them proactively to ensure that production downtime is minimized, and SLAs are achieved
  • Conduct InfoSec activities and ID management of Voice devices on a daily, weekly, monthly and quarterly basis to ensure that all devices are compliant with zero deviations per the InfoSec calendar
  • Execute day-to-day network activities as part of Incident management and Change management processes to ensure end users requests are handled and addressed within the defined SLA's
  • Proactively evaluate new and emerging technologies and suggest ways to add value to the existing infrastructure
  • Author and deliver network related documentation
  • Ensure an effective communication process is in place with all the stakeholders including vendors, server, voice, and desktop support teams
  • You will design, implement and manage with us complex network solutions to meet organizational requirements.
  • Monitor and optimize network performance, addressing issues promptly to minimize downtime.
  • You will collaborate with us, a cross-functional team to integrate new technologies and ensure seamless network operation.

Job ID: 2852316 | Amazon Servicos de Varejo do Brasil Ltda.

Esta é uma vaga que tem o intuito de coletar talentos para posições futuras e é uma posição de contribuidor individual.

A Amazon Brasil valoriza a Diversidade, Equidade e Inclusão (DEI) em todas as nossas posições de trabalho. Nossa liderança é engajada e entende cada dia mais o seu papel na disseminação e prática dos nossos princípios de liderança, com o objetivo de sermos “a melhor empresa para se trabalhar do mundo”. Nossos grupos de afinidade são formados por pessoas voluntárias de diferentes unidades de negócio e são parte ativa na definição das estratégias de DEI.

Strategic Vendor Services (SVS) é um serviço que visa ajudar marcas e parcerias estratégicas a se desenvolverem de maneira sustentável com a Amazon. Nesta posição comercial, como especialista de contas chave na equipe SVS, você ganhará exposição de 360 graus em todas as áreas do e-commerce, sendo responsável por todo o relacionamento com suas marcas e aconselhando seus principais parceiros de gerenciamento de contas.

Você definirá e implementará planos de ação sob medida para impulsionar o desempenho de suas marcas, monitorar as métricas de sucesso diariamente e garantir que a experiência da marca no serviço SVS esteja no mais alto nível. Você irá colaborar com as principais funções de varejo, como Vendor Managers, InStock Managers, Finanças e Category Marketing Managers.

Nesta posição, você irá gerenciar fornecedores de alta complexidade, trabalhando com autonomia para entregar o serviço. Você também será responsável por projetos de médio a alto impacto, atingindo especialistas de contas chave SVS em várias categorias de produtos e implementando melhorias de processos escaláveis para todo o varejo da Amazon.

Key job responsibilities

  • Aconselhamento de Negócios:
    - Identificar oportunidades analisando dados, fornecer recomendações para melhorar as vendas com sustentabilidade e maximizar a lucratividade e crescimento do negócio à longo prazo da Amazon e do parceiro;
    - Gerir relacionamento com parceiros de ponta a ponta;
    - Analisar financeiramente oportunidades para atender/superar metas de receita/lucro para seus fornecedores.
  • Seleção de Produtos:
    - Facilitar o aumento do catálogo gerenciando novos lançamentos, melhorando a descoberta/navegação;
    - Negociar e garantir produtos das marcas mais relevantes na Amazon.
  • Disponibilidade de Produto:
    - Garantir disponibilidade dos produtos aos clientes ao trabalhar com um Especialista de Supply Chain.
  • Tráfego:
    - Recomendar campanhas de marketing/publicidade das marcas promovendo lançamentos/aumentando tráfego ou conversão.
  • Conversão:
    - Planejar e implementar promoções, melhorar a jornada do cliente da Amazon por meio de conteúdo avançado.

Requisitos:

  • Bacharelado/Licenciatura;
  • Forte habilidade de comunicação escrita e verbal;
  • Forte habilidade em análises quantitativas/analíticas;
  • Experiência sólida na área comercial, e-commerce e/ou varejo;
  • Comunicação escrita e verbal avançada em Inglês;
  • Experiência com SQL;
  • Experiência com painéis de dados (QuickSight, QlikSense, Power BI, Tableau);
  • Experiência com gestão de pessoas/times;

Sobre a Oportunidade

Essa oportunidade é para vaga de Gerente de Modelagem na área de Risco de Crédito. Você será responsável por todo ciclo de modelos utilizados pela instituição para concessão, manutenção e recuperação de crédito, além dos parâmetros e ferramentas para mensuração de perdas de crédito. Buscamos profissionais com mente aberta e espírito empreendedor com vontade de crescer e desenvolver uma área em evolução.

Principais responsabilidades:

  • Liderar o time de modelagem de risco de crédito

  • Construir parâmetros de riscos de crédito associados à Res. 4.966 e IFRS9.
  • Monitorar modelos e interagir no processo de validação e inspeção com áreas internas, auditoria e reguladores.
  • Participar da implementação da infraestrutura de dados e modelos.
  • Participar em comitês e discussões sobre o uso de modelos nas políticas de crédito e no processo de provisão de perdas esperadas.

Pré-requisitos Essenciais:

  • Ter a nossa cultura e espírito empreendedor.
  • Experiência no gerenciamento de equipes
  • Experiência consolidada na construção e monitoramento de modelos de risco de crédito para diferentes públicos
  • Conhecimento no uso de ferramentas para gerenciamento de dados

Diferenciais:

  • Experiência em risco de crédito e modelagem no segmento Atacado

Triagem inicial: Análise do currículo para verificar a adequação às qualificações e requisitos da vaga.

Testes gerais: Avaliação do alinhamento cultural com o teste da Mindsight e teste de raciocínio lógico da Predictive Index.

Entrevista com a equipe de Recrutamento: Discussão sobre as expectativas em relação à vaga e aos objetivos profissionais.

Entrevista com a liderança: Uma conversa para discutir sua visão e como você pode contribuir para a equipe e a empresa.

Entrevista com colegas de trabalho: Interação com futuros pares para avaliar a sinergia e o trabalho em equipe.

Entrevista focada em cultura: Exploração dos valores e princípios da empresa para garantir um bom encaixe cultural.

Oferta: Apresentação da proposta de trabalho, incluindo detalhes sobre remuneração e benefícios.

  • Saúde e bem-estar: plano de saúde, plano odontológico, Gympass, Zenklub, VA, VR, New Value, seguro de vida.
  • Maternidade e Paternidade: auxílio creche para pais e mães, licença maternidade de 6 meses, licença paternidade de 20 dias.
  • Só na XP Inc.: assessoria de investimento e acesso a fundos de investimentos exclusivos.

Jornada de trabalho com flexibilidade:

O nosso modelo de trabalho varia de acordo com a função: presencial para frentes de negócio e híbrido para as demais equipes. É importante ressaltar que todos os colaboradores precisam morar na localidade da vaga (nossa sede está localizada na cidade de São Paulo e é onde temos o maior número de posições), já que temos atividades que exigem a presença física para promover a colaboração e os rituais da nossa cultura. Esses encontros são organizados de acordo com as orientações dos líderes e as particularidades de cada rotina, para que nossos colaboradores possam exercer suas jornadas de trabalho com liberdade e autonomia.

We are seeking a highly skilled Platform Component Leader to lead the development and maintenance of the foundational software platform for our embedded systems. This role focuses on low-level programming, hardware integration, and providing a robust foundation to support application development. The ideal candidate will have deep expertise in Linux systems, drivers and kernel programming, hardware abstraction layers, board support packages (BSPs), image building using Yocto, and embedded software in general, ensuring the platform is optimized for performance, scalability, and flexibility.

This position is critical for enabling application teams to build innovative solutions by providing the tools, abstraction layers, and system support they need. They will ensure the efficient development of high-quality software components while aligning with the broader team’s goals and collaborating with the Product Owner, Technical Leader, other Component Leaders and stakeholders.

Key Responsibilities:

  1. Lead Platform Development: Lead the development and maintenance of core platform components, including kernel modules, device drivers, board support packages (BSPs), and hardware abstraction layers, ensuring seamless integration with hardware and higher-level software layers.
  2. System Image Customization: Lead the creation of Linux-based system images using the Yocto Project, tailoring configurations to meet specific hardware and project requirements.
  3. Platform Tooling and Abstraction Layers: Build and maintain tools, APIs, and abstraction layers that simplify application development. Provide a reliable and efficient platform that enables application teams to focus on delivering innovative solutions.
  4. Team Leadership and Mentorship: Lead and mentor a team of developers focused on platform development. Cultivate technical growth within the team by sharing expertise in embedded software development. Promote a culture of collaboration, innovation, and accountability to achieve high-quality deliverables.
  5. Planning and Transparency: Track team progress and ensure alignment with project timelines and deliverables. Maintain clear visibility into development activities, identify risks early, and adjust plans as needed to meet committed deadlines. Report progress and challenges to stakeholders to ensure transparency and accountability.
  6. Collaboration and Team Work: Work closely with the Technical Leader, Product Owner, other Component Leaders and stakeholders to align platform development with broader project goals. Collaborate with hardware engineers, platform, application and test automation teams to ensure seamless integration and optimal performance across the solution.

Qualifications:

  1. Education: Bachelor’s degree in Business, Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field.
  2. Experience: 7+ years of experience in embedded systems development, with a focus on low-level programming and Linux-based platforms.
  3. Skills:
    • Strong knowledge of embedded Linux systems, kernel programming, and hardware-software integration.
    • Experience with the Yocto Project for system image building and customization.
    • Proficiency in developing device drivers, BSPs, and hardware abstraction layers.
    • Familiarity with hardware and networking communication protocols such as SPI, I2C, UART, CAN, Ethernet, TCP/IP, GSM.
    • Strong experience with troubleshooting of complex problems in diverse environments.
    • Basic knowledge for reading electronic schematics and datasheets.
    • Familiarity with end-to-end testing approaches and test automation, preferably with hardware-in-the-loop testing, to ensure reliable integration and quality of embedded systems.
    • Experience with Agile methodologies, backlog prioritization, and tools like JIRA and Confluence.
  4. Soft Skills:
    • Strong ability to interact and align with stakeholders and technical leaders across the company, ensuring effective communication and shared understanding of project goals.
    • Proven ability to contribute to a collaborative team environment, always working as a team player and actively supporting colleagues and driving collective success.
    • Highly collaborative with excellent organizational and interpersonal skills.
    • Clear and effective communicator, able to explain technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders.
    • Ability to work in a fast-paced, global environment, managing multiple priorities and adjusting to shifting requirements.
  5. Language: Proficient English communication skills, both written and spoken.

This role will involve the scaling out of the platform to multiple Lines of Business (Customer Journeys) making long term decisions that will guide the rollout.

Drive the strategic vision and implementation of AEP solutions to enhance our digital marketing capabilities.

Oversee the design, development, and deployment of AEP components.

Manage multiple engineering projects, ensuring timely delivery and alignment with business objectives.

Strong in Data Engineering and System Integration.

Experience in Content Management Systems (CMS) would be advantageous.

Partner with business stakeholders to understand their needs and translate them into technical solutions.

Communicate project progress, challenges, and successes to senior management and other stakeholders.

Act as a subject matter expert for AEP, providing insights and recommendations to drive business growth.

Champion the implementation of IT policies across multiple teams, influencing the department's overall compliance landscape.

Oversee the development and optimization of department-wide processes, ensuring they incorporate evolving IT/Cyber governance best practices.

Strategic partner with governance teams, advocating for necessary policy updates and contributing to risk assessments.

So are YOU our next Senior Manager, Software Engineering, Marketing Platform Engineering ? You are, if you have…

Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field.

8+ years of experience in software engineering, with at least 3 years in a leadership role.

Extensive experience with Adobe Experience Platform and its components (Adobe Real-Time CDP, Adobe Journey Optimizer, and Adobe Target).

Proven track record of managing and delivering complex engineering projects in the digital marketing space.

Strong understanding of financial services and digital marketing trends.

Excellent leadership, communication, and interpersonal skills.

Ability to work in a fast-paced, dynamic environment and manage multiple priorities.

Preferred Qualifications:

Experience with cloud platforms/ capabilities such as AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud.

Familiarity with data privacy regulations and compliance in the financial services industry.

Certification in Adobe Experience Platform or related technologies.

We are hiring a Senior Site Reliability Engineer
Next-gen operations at scale, with pure Python infra-as-code, from bare metal to containers and applications. Our goal is to perfect enterprise infrastructure devops.

To succeed in this role you need to believe in automation as a pure software engineering problem, not a hack-it-till-it-works-for-me problem. Our cloud operations engineers bring Python software-engineering skills and rigour to the operations domain. We practise devsecops from bare metal to application. We architect and run OpenStack, Kubernetes and software defined storage, and we enable devsecops for applications running on that infrastructure too.
To become a member of this team, you need to be a software engineer fluent in Python, you need a genuine interest in the full open source infrastructure stack from metal to containers, and you need the ability to work in a high pressure operations environment with mission-critical services for global brand name customers.
As a member of the team you will gain experience in a broad range of cloud technologies. We evolve our offerings as the state of the art improves, so you get to stay current with the latest capabilities in open source infrastructure.   • Participate in sprint planning activities and lead QA team members in the estimating planning, scheduling and performing of automated and manual testing
  • Setup and configure test environments and import test data
  • Work closely with Software Engineers to perform early testing on components prior to integration builds
  • Manage defect tracking and proactively identify risks to management; monitor and report results
  • Perform root cause analysis of defects, conduct lessons learned meetings and propose improvements in processes and methodologies
  • Report QA status, as appropriate, to keep project stakeholders informed on deliverables and timelines
  • Foster a continuous improvement approach to QA activities
  • Perform automation scripting code reviews and encourage best practices amongst QA engineers.

So are YOU our next Senior Quality Assurance Engineer? You are if you have…

  • BS in computer science or related field
  • Minimum of 5 years’ experience as QA Analyst role with solid progression in responsibility
  • 5+ years' experience with developing QA automation scripts for web applications, including Angular single page applications
  • Expert knowledge of Playwright E2E testing Framework

  • Knowledge of software development lifecycle, methodology and testing

  • Ability to apply concepts of system, regression, product, integration and acceptance testing to web application features
  • Excellent problem solving and analytical skills with the ability to investigate and research multiple sources
  • Highly organized, self-starter and comfortable working in an Agile environment
  • Excellent presentation and interpersonal skills
  • Brownie points if experienced on Typescript

Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. We are hiring an Engineering Manager for IAM (Identity and Access Management) to build high-performing Go and Python services and secure identity and access management solutions that will be used across all company products. From Ubuntu One SSO to Juju, LXD and MAAS your team will define the way Canonical users, clients and community members access their favorite open source applications.
This is an opportunity for a software engineering manager with a passion for distributed systems operations to help us transform the future of identity management at Canonical. Experience in the identity and access management (IAM) field is desirable but not required. As the identity team engineering manager you will bring significant software development experience, Kubernetes knowledge and a keen eye for software design, performance and security. You will be responsible for working with product management to define the technical vision for the products, managing the team backlog, reviewing code and coaching younger team members.
You will also be involved in all the aspects of the software development process: you will design software, write high-quality code and tests, provide insightful code reviews, write documentation and help to troubleshoot issues.
In addition to the engineering behind the project itself, you'll have the chance to work with industry-leading teams inside Canonical, ensuring your work is backed by rock-solid data stores, and highly observable using our Kubernetes-based Observability stack. You'll work with broader open source communities, participating in "hackfest" events, webinars and conferences.
Location: This role will be based remotely in the EMEA or AMER regions.

As an engineering manager at Canonical your primary responsibility is to the people you support: ensuring that they are growing as engineers, doing valuable work, and generally having a great time at Canonical. As a lead for strong engineers, technical leadership and a solid background in software development is a must, so that you're able to challenge and grow your team members. You will have the opportunity to influence the culture, facilitate technical delivery, and work with your team on strategy and execution.
We work in Python and Golang, and expect engineering managers to be fluent in the language, architecture and components that their team is building with. Title: Application Modernization Specialist

Job Type: Full-Time

Location: Remote

Company Description:

Mechanized AI is at the forefront of AI innovation, leveraging cutting-edge technology to transform legacy systems into modern, efficient, and scalable solutions. We work with enterprise clients to breathe life into their existing software, ensuring that they can meet the demands of today’s fast-paced, digital landscape. Our team thrives on solving complex challenges and delivering innovative solutions. As an organization, we are committed to fostering an environment that encourages creativity, collaboration, and continuous learning.

Job Summary:

We are seeking an experienced Application Modernization Specialist to join our growing team. The ideal candidate will have a background in software architecture and extensive experience leading modernization projects. While expertise in migrating from COBOL to newer programming languages is highly desirable, we are also open to candidates with a track record of successfully transforming other legacy systems to modern technologies.

Key Responsibilities:

  1. Lead and execute software modernization projects, ensuring the seamless transition from legacy systems to modern, scalable architectures.
  2. Analyze existing legacy codebases to understand business logic, dependencies, and potential risks during migration.
  3. Design and implement solutions that maintain the integrity and functionality of legacy systems while improving performance, scalability, and maintainability.
  4. Collaborate closely with cross-functional teams, including developers, business analysts, and project managers, to ensure successful project delivery.
  5. Provide technical leadership and guidance to development teams throughout the modernization process.
  6. Identify and mitigate risks associated with legacy system migrations, ensuring minimal disruption to business operations.
  7. Document architectural designs, migration strategies, and other technical details to ensure transparency and knowledge sharing within the team.
  8. Stay current with emerging technologies and best practices in software modernization to continuously improve our methodologies and tools.

Required Skills & Experience:

  1. Bachelor’s degree in computer science, software engineering or related field.
  2. Experience as a Software Architect or Senior Developer focused on modernization projects.
  3. Client delivery experience.
  4. Expertise migrating legacy systems, preferably from COBOL to modern languages such as Java, C#, Python, or similar.
  5. Deep understanding of software architecture principles, design patterns, and best practices.
  6. Experience with tools and methodologies for code analysis, refactoring, and automated testing.
  7. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with ability to propose innovative solutions and troubleshoot issues.
  8. Ability to work independently and as part of a collaborative team in a fast-paced environment.
  9. Effective written and oral communications skills – C1/C2 (advanced/proficient) level English is required.

Preferred Qualifications:

  1. Experience with cloud platforms (e.g., AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud) in the context of modernization projects.
  2. Knowledge of containerization technologies (e.g., Docker, Kubernetes) and microservices architecture.
  3. Familiarity with DevOps practices and tools, including CI/CD pipelines.

Who We Are

Welcome to TELUS Digital — where innovation drives impact at a global scale. Location and Flexibility

This requires the ability to work on-site from ourSão Paulo - SP or Porto Alegre - RS office throughout the week based on team needs, while still providing the flexibility to work remotely on other days. Our in-office culture is designed to foster in-person innovation, collaboration, and connection with team members local and visiting from other global offices.

The Opportunity

As a Staff Android Software Engineer, you will design, develop, and maintain Android applications that meet business and technical requirements. You will work closely with cross-functional teams to gather requirements, design solutions, and implement features. You will also mentor and support junior software engineers and other teammates, fostering their professional growth.

Responsibilities

  • Design and build high-quality Android applications to meet our clients’ business and technical needs.
  • Take ownership of major features and components, from design to implementation and deployment.
  • Collaborate closely with clients and cross-functional teams to gather requirements, design solutions, and implement features.
  • Provide technical leadership and guidance to the development team; mentor and coach engineers and promote a culture of quality and learning
  • Effectively present complex technical and project-related information to partners in both spoken, written, and presentation forms.
  • Design and architect robust networking and data modeling layers.
  • Champion programming best practices, including SOLID principles and modular design.
  • Collaborate with other senior engineers to improve code quality, testability, and maintainability.
  • Enjoy contributing and guiding engineers across projects while following platform-level design patterns where appropriate.
  • Understand best practices for making applications observable and understand the “why” with regard to the data that is being collected.
  • Identify when and how technical debt should be paid off to avoid potential re-work or additional debt.
  • Articulate the trade-offs around large refactors and foster alignment with our client stakeholders and project team.
  • Contribute to thought leadership in the industry (e.g., contributing to blogs, giving talks at industry events, participating in local platform meetups, and open-source contributions).

Qualifications

  • 10+ years of professional programming experience, with at least 8 years of experience in Android development.
  • Extensive experience with the Android development lifecycle and ecosystem, including Java, Kotlin, Room, Coroutines/Flow, RxJava, Dagger 2, Gradle, Fragments, OkHttp3, Retrofit or Volley.
  • Proficient using IDEs, version control systems such as Git, and command line tools.
  • Strong understanding of CI/CD principles and experience setting up deployment pipelines.
  • Experience with automated testing frameworks such as Espresso, JUnit, and Mockito/Mockk.
  • Deep knowledge of programming best practices and different architectural patterns (e.g., MVC, MVVM).
  • Passionate about delivering durable, secure, scalable, and high-performance code.
  • Excellent problem-solving and analytical skills, with a solution-oriented mindset.
  • Collaborative, communicative, and able to work effectively in a team.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
  • Strong mentoring and leadership skills.

Why TELUS Digital ?

What We Offer:

  • Be part of an innovative consultancy with a human-centered and culture with opportunities for ownership and professional growth
  • Competitive salary and benefits package (annual bonus)
  • Opportunity to work on innovative agile projects with other high-performing, passionate team members from all over the globe (international travel opportunities)
  • Collaborative work environment that encourages continuous learning and professional development (including English classes, support in national and international courses,
  • Flexible work hours and autonomy
  • Voucher for health activities, food allowance, in-office snacks, drinks, and games

If you love IT as much as we do, we look forward to meeting you!

Equal Opportunity Employer

description:
Sr. Special Projects Manager, Customer Experience and Business Trends

Amazon is seeking an experienced Sr. Product Manager based in Sao Paulo, Brazil for Customer Experience and Business Trends (CXBT). The team focuses on improving customer experience at Amazon globally.

The Sr. Product Manager will be responsible for deep diving into a specific customer area and driving our team's strategy and long-term plans for this customer. The ideal candidate will operate with an entrepreneurial mindset, passion for business development and problem solving at scale, and have P/L ownership. The candidate will own end-to-end delivery of projects and is responsible for partnering with team leaders and compliance officers within the team and across Amazon to deliver team’s objectives. The candidate will be part of a global and diverse team and working on multiple competing projects spanning across time zones.

The role will be a good fit if you:

  1. Are a self-starter, entrepreneurial and like working with ambiguity.
  2. Are interested in solving customer problems by diving deep into issues.
  3. Are adept at managing competing priorities from different stakeholders and influencing them without authority.
  4. Are hands-on in solving business problems and then identifying technology based solutions to fix these.
  5. Have experience working with teams spread globally.
  6. Have experience working with the ecommerce seller space.
  7. Have a good understanding of the prevailing laws and statutes in Brazil in the ecommerce selling space.

Key job responsibilities

  1. Conduct a feasibility analysis for setting up foundational customer experience improvement capabilities.
  2. Gain a deep understanding of operating environment, risks and challenges by liaising with cross-functional groups, including business teams, finance, sales, technology, support, fulfillment, and supply chain.
  3. Assist in building annual plans, goal delivery, and maintaining overall budget.
  4. Continuously provide contribution on innovating and improving processes driving simplification and automation across the team.
  5. Influence Amazon leaders to improve their current customer facing solutions for the specific customer cohort based on the studies delivered by the team.
  6. Collaborate with internal business partners to ensure project output is leveraged to its fullest extent.

About the team

Customer Experience and Business Trends (CXBT) is an organization made up of a diverse suite of functions dedicated to deeply understanding and improving customer experience, globally. We are a team of builders that develop products, services, ideas, and various ways of leveraging data to influence product and service offerings for almost every business at Amazon - for every customer (e.g., consumers, developers, sellers/brands, employees, investors, streamers, gamers).

Our approach is based on determining the customer needs, along with problem solving, and we work backwards from there. We use technical and non-technical approaches and stay aware of industry and business trends. We are a global team, made up of a diverse set of profiles, skills, and backgrounds - including: Product Managers, Software Developers, Computer Vision experts, Solution Architects, Data Scientists, Business Intelligence Engineers, Business Analysts, Risk Managers, and more.

BASIC QUALIFICATIONS

  1. Product or program management, product marketing, business development or technology experience.
  2. Bachelor's degree or equivalent.
  3. Experience owning/driving roadmap strategy and definition.
  4. Experience as a product manager or owner.
  5. Experience owning technology products.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

  1. Experience in influencing senior leadership through data driven insights.
  2. Experience working across functional teams and senior stakeholders.

Who We Are:

At OKX, we believe that the future will be reshaped by Crypto, ultimately contributing to every individual's freedom.

OKX began as a crypto exchange giving millions of people access to crypto trading and over time becoming among the largest platforms in the world. In recent years, we have developed one of the most connected Web3 wallets used by millions to access decentralized crypto applications (dApps).

OKX is a trusted brand by hundreds of large institutions seeking access to crypto markets on a reliable platform that seamlessly connects with global banking and payments. In the last year, OKX has expanded into new markets including Australia, Brazil, Netherlands, Singapore and Turkey, with plans to launch in the US, Belgium and the UAE.

We are deeply committed to shaping a fairer, more transparent and accessible society through blockchain technology. This is why we publish proof of reserves monthly, and continue to ship new innovative security features.

About the Opportunity:

The Senior Audit Manager, FinCrime (LACC) will manage the internal audit function for financial crimes, including Anti-Money Laundering (AML), Counter-Terrorist Financing (CTF), sanctions compliance, fraud prevention, and other financial crime-related activities. This role ensures that the organization's financial crime risk management and compliance frameworks are robust, effective, and aligned with regulatory expectations.

Key Responsibilities:

  1. Strategic Leadership
    • Develop and implement the annual audit plan for financial crimes, ensuring alignment with the organization's strategic goals and regulatory requirements.
    • Advise senior management on financial crime-related risks, control gaps, and regulatory trends.
    • Act as a subject matter expert for financial crimes audit, providing strategic insights and guidance.
  2. Audit Execution
    • Lead end-to-end audits covering AML/CTF, sanctions compliance, fraud detection, and other financial crime programs.
    • Assess the effectiveness of policies, procedures, controls, and systems designed to mitigate financial crime risks.
    • Monitor compliance with local and global regulatory requirements (e.g., AML, FATF, OFAC sanctions, etc.).
    • Ensure that audits are conducted efficiently, with clear and actionable recommendations provided to management.
  3. Team Management
    • Foster and contribute to a culture of collaboration, excellence, and continuous improvement within the audit team.
    • Coordinate with colleagues located globally, as well the potential to manage performance of small teams to ensure the delivery of high-quality audit reports.
  4. Stakeholder Management
    • Build and maintain strong relationships with key stakeholders, including Compliance, Risk Management, Legal, and external regulators.
    • Participate in governance forums, presenting audit findings and updates related to financial crimes risk.
    • Provide proactive insights into emerging financial crime risks and regulatory changes.
  5. Regulatory and Industry Knowledge
    • Stay up to date with regulatory developments, industry best practices, and emerging threats in financial crime risk management.
    • Ensure the organization's financial crime audit approach aligns with regulatory expectations and global standards.
  6. Reporting
    • Prepare and deliver comprehensive, timely, and accurate audit work papers and reports to senior management and the Audit Committee.
    • Track and validate the remediation of audit findings to ensure timely resolution.

What We're Looking For:

Experience: Strong experience (8+ years) in internal audit, including leadership roles in Financial Crimes at a leading global financial institution, fintech, or Big 4 firm. Experience in crypto, digital assets, or blockchain is a plus.

Expertise: Deep knowledge of AML, CTF, and sanctions regulatory expectations for financial services, and cutting-edge audit methodologies. Familiarity with data analytics and emerging audit technologies is highly desirable.

Leadership: Proven ability to lead and inspire cross-functional teams in a fast-paced, high-growth environment.

Communication: Exceptional ability to articulate complex ideas to diverse audiences, including regulators and senior leadership.

Certifications: ACAMS required. CPA, CIA, or similar credentials are also preferred. Advanced certifications (e.g., CISA, CFA) are a plus.

Education: Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, Business Administration, or a related field. Law degree or equivalent preferred.

Benefits:

The professional registered nurse Outpatient RN CAP 1 is an entry level designation into the Clinical Advancement Program (CAP).   1. Performs all essential functions under the direction of the Supervisor and with guidance from the Clinical Educator, Preceptor, or in collaboration with other Registered Nurses.

  3. Assesses, collaborates, and documents patient/family’s basic learning needs to provide initial and ongoing education to patients and family.

Supervision:

Oversee Patient Care Technicians/LPNs/LVNs/RNs as a Team Leader or Nurse in Charge after meeting specific experience and training requirements.

Education And Licensure:

  • Graduate of an accredited School of Nursing.
  • Current state licensure.
  • CPR/BLS Certification.
  • Meet practice requirements of the employing state.

Experience And Skills:

  • Entry level for RNs with less than 2 years of Nephrology Nursing experience.
  • Preferred: Chronic/acute hemodialysis experience.
